subproblems.title: The mass measure of a current on ℝ^P vanishes off the support of the current
subproblems.statement: Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (VO) (verbatim the antecedent (VO) of the selected statement): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose tsupport is disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (a current on U = univ) and let μ be a measure on ℝ^P such that M_W(X) = μ(W) for every open set W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then μ(ℝ^P \ spt X) = 0, i.e. μ((spt X)ᶜ) = 0. Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step (1d) of the parent-supplied proof of the selected node dimred_mbl_dtsd_shell_decomposition (used there for T and, in step 2, for ∂T); Simon, Introduction to GMT, Ch. 6, §5, proof of the deformation theorem 5.1, displays (8)–(10) (book/chapter-06.txt lines 1725–1740).
1. (The complement of the support is the open zero region.) By definition, spt X = ℝ^P \ Z with Z := X.zeroRegion, the union of all open W with compact closure (contained in ℝ^P) on which X vanishes. Hence (spt X)ᶜ = Z (the complement of univ \ Z is Z), and Z is open, being a union of open sets (GeometricCurrentOn.isOpen_zeroRegion).
2. By the hypothesis applied to the open set W := Z, μ((spt X)ᶜ) = μ(Z) = M_Z(X), and by definition M_Z(X) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) admissible for M_Z (tsupport ω ⊆ Z and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x).
3. Let ω be admissible for M_Z. Then tsupport ω ⊆ Z = (spt X)ᶜ, so tsupport ω is disjoint from spt X (Set.disjoint_of_subset_left with disjoint_compl_left). By (VO), applied with U := ℝ^P and S := X, X(ω) = 0, hence ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) = ENNReal.ofReal 0 = 0.
4. Every element of the set whose supremum is M_Z(X) is therefore 0, so M_Z(X) ≤ 0 (sSup_le), i.e. M_Z(X) = 0. By step 2, μ((spt X)ᶜ) = 0. ∎
